name: Weather House
summary: A carved wooden weather house where a sun lady and a rain man swap places as the humidity rises
about: A little chalet with a shingled roof, flower boxes and a humidity dial hangs from a porch beam under bunting. Turn the humidity up and its springy turntable swings the sun lady back into her doorway while the rain man steps out under his umbrella, the needle swings, clouds gather and rain, wind and lightning fill the sky; dry it out again and a rainbow appears. Good for a weather or travel page, a toy shop or a playful settings control.
how: Drag the Humidity slider (or use the arrow keys), or pick Sunny, Cloudy, Rainy or Stormy.
The turntable follows on a springy string: one figure steps out and leans as it turns, the other fades into the dark doorway.
The sky behind the porch blends between sun, clouds, rain and a storm with lightning that rattles the house; after rain, a rainbow.
Tap the house (or focus it and press Enter) and it swings on its nail while the carved bird sings.
With reduced motion the house barely swings, the rain hangs still, lightning is a soft glow and the turntable moves without bounce.
